name: DC-DEADCAST
description: A performance-focused Dreamcast emulator with recomp modules.
author: tyrannotorus

changelog.1.2.0:
- Recomp modules now run alongside Deadcast, which sleeps while they play: MENU, the menu and the store are always Deadcast's
- New: Recomp Store on the main page: browse, download, update and delete recomp modules
- Options shows the options of the core you pick; switching cores asks for a restart
- Each recomp module keeps its own settings, and can let you remap its buttons (Options > Controls)
- Updating the module you are playing restarts your game when you press A
- If a recomp module fails, Deadcast shows the error and offers the emulator; switch back in Options, or update or delete it in the Recomp Store
- Recomp modules from before 1.2.0 need updating in the Recomp Store
- One look for on-screen text: the frame counter and messages use the menu's font, in the emulator and in recomp modules alike
- Flycast's old menus and overlay are gone
- RetroAchievements removed: it had no menu left to sign in from
changelog.1.1.1:
- Most games tested run at nearly full speed on Brick hardware
- The screen refreshes at close to the Dreamcast's 59.94 Hz instead of 60.2 Hz
- Save-state pictures are no longer garbled
- Daytona USA: car decals display correctly
- New: Delete Recomp Module (Options > Recomp Options) removes the module, its saves and its settings
- An interrupted module install is cleaned up at the next start
- Rez recomp module 1.0.2: opening the menu no longer shows garbled graphics
